name: imbrace-developer
description: Build on the iMBrace platform: get started, use the TypeScript/Python SDK, connect the hosted MCP server, drive the CLI, and build AI agents, workflows, knowledge hubs and CRM boards.

interface.longDescription:
Skills that teach the model how to build on iMBrace, the customer-engagement platform for CRM data boards, conversations, AI agents, workflows and knowledge hubs.

- Get started: pick an environment, get an API key safely, and make a first verified call.
- SDK: write correct TypeScript (@imbrace/sdk) and Python (imbrace) code, with the right credential, namespaces and error handling.
- MCP: connect Codex, Cursor or other MCP clients to the iMBrace hosted MCP server, with OAuth sign-in where the gateway supports it or an API key, and the least access needed.
- CLI: install, sign in and script the imbrace CLI for boards, AI agents and workflows.
- Build: create an AI agent, stream chat, publish a workflow the agent can call, attach a knowledge hub and model CRM boards.

Documentation: https://engineer.imbrace.co
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with iMBrace
Write a TypeScript script that lists my iMBrace boards
Build a support bot on iMBrace that can call a workflow
